Hide from Approvals Page
fields.description: Approvals for this document type are not listed on the Approvals page. The workflow still runs and the document is still approved from its own form - only the inbox listing is suppressed. Use for document types that have their own dedicated screen, or whose volume would drown the inbox.

fields.label: Restrict Editing to the Role on Each State
fields.description:
Off (the default): while a document is in this workflow, editing follows the normal ERPNext permissions - anyone with write access to the doctype may correct it. On: only the role named in Allow Edit on the document's current state may edit it, and everyone else sees the form read-only.

Leave it off unless you have a reason to restrict. Allow Edit holds a single role, but a state can have several approvers - a Purchase Invoice at Pending can be approved by any of six roles depending on its group and currency - so restricting makes five of them able to approve a document they cannot correct.
If checked, workflow status will not override status in list view.
fields.label: Don't Override Status
